page.title: Code labels
page.lede: The words Nphies gives its codes. Upload a workbook from a new release to read which labels it changes and what its change log adds.

upload.title: Upload a Nphies workbook
upload.hint: The Codeable Concept, validation rule or profiles workbook, as an Excel file. An unknown layout or an older version is refused. An upload takes effect at once, with no second approver, and is logged.
upload.failed: The workbook could not be uploaded.
